instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot. On an outdoor cobblestone path next to a rustic stone wall, the woman in the polka-dot dress (R2) on the left dances gracefully while holding hands with the man in the brown fedora and white shirt (R1) on the right. The man holds his silver saxophone in one hand and extends his other hand to connect with hers. Natural daylight casts soft shadows across the scene, highlighting their joyful interaction and the green foliage in the background.
